info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Servicing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Servicing Issue Lookup API provides a streamlined way to access servicing issues related to specific parameters. By querying with 'param1', users can retrieve detailed information on various servicing requests and their statuses. This API is particularly useful for customer service representatives and support teams who need to diagnose and address customer inquiries efficiently. It enables organizations to enhance their responses and improve service delivery through quick access to relevant data.

get.summary: Retrieve servicing issue details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific servicing issue using its unique identifier. Make sure to provide a valid servicing issue ID to receive the corresponding data.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the necessary details for retrieving servicing issue RES-100045. Clients should ensure that the request includes all required fields according to the defined schema.
